scientific_limitations: The theorem excludes only a prescribed countable family of noncomputable targets whose uniform join is reducible to B. It does not prove that the two witnesses form a minimal pair or that every nonzero common lower bound is excluded. Uniform reducibility of the whole family to B is used to code all targets into one D equivalent to B.
title: A fixed cupping pair simultaneously excludes any prescribed countable family below the target
